basement_world_floor_gate.applies_to: Every rebuilt basement, crypt, mine, tunnel and other cavity intersecting world ground
basement_world_floor_gate.required_authority: Persisted editor AdaptiveTerrainTopology punched leaves exported by TerrainEntranceMesh; identical missing faces in render and physical/optical queries
required_evidence: saved/reopened topology and source-bound mesh hashes
basement_world_floor_gate.rule: Architectural floor voids alone do not pass; no transparency, replacement invisible supports or render-only clipping. Audit every site independently.

search_envelope_gate.rule: Count actual traversable spaces including circulation; preserve coherent sealed context and prevent objective/ghost/interaction leakage. Build maps; round-duration testing is outside this task.
